# Objective-C's needsMap recurses through class properties: a class that
# requires itself (with no map or array type anywhere in the graph) makes
# it recurse until V8's stack overflows, but only when the implementation
# file asks (not with --just-types or --features interface). An optional
# self-reference is a nullable union, which needsMap does not enter.
input schema Node {"type": "object", "properties": {"value": {"type": "integer"}, "next": {"$ref": "#"}}, "required": ["value", "next"]}
input schema Chain {"type": "object", "properties": {"value": {"type": "integer"}, "next": {"$ref": "#"}}, "required": ["value"]}
pipeline {"lang": "objc"}

render objc {}
render objc {"rendererOptions": {"features": "interface"}}
render objc {"rendererOptions": {"just-types": true}}
